name: tessera
description: Tessera — ERC-3643 RWA tokenization & compliance platform (monorepo root)

scripts.contracts:deploy:local: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; forge script contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --root contracts --rpc-url ${RPC_URL_LOCAL:-http://127.0.0.1:8545} --broadcast
scripts.contracts:seed:local: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; forge script contracts/script/Seed.s.sol:Seed --root contracts --rpc-url ${RPC_URL_LOCAL:-http://127.0.0.1:8545} --broadcast
scripts.contracts:deploy:amoy: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; forge script contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --root contracts --rpc-url amoy --broadcast --verify --slow --confirmations ${CONFIRMATIONS:-3}
scripts.contracts:seed:amoy: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; forge script contracts/script/Seed.s.sol:Seed --root contracts --rpc-url amoy --broadcast --slow --confirmations ${CONFIRMATIONS:-3}
scripts.contracts:verify:amoy: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; forge verify-contract --root contracts --chain amoy --etherscan-api-key ${POLYGONSCAN_API_KEY} --watch
